intake.domain: Frozen, training-free inference acceleration for joint World Action Models (WAMs) that iteratively generate future visual latents and action chunks.
intake.venue: 未指定；按FYP方法/系统研究诊断处理，不推断投稿周期。
intake.time: 未指定；本轮资料截止 2026-10-02，未假设投稿期限。
data: Sparse-WAM paper-reported LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus and RoboLab-120 results; this round performs no new evaluation.

Potential simulation routes in the feasibility notes: FastWAM/LIBERO and Cosmos3-Edge/RoboLab. Motus/RoboTwin 2.0 is only a conditional simulation fallback if the matching FastWAM-Joint checkpoint is unavailable, not an equivalent baseline.

Sparse-WAM's physical route is AgileX Cobot Magic with task-specific FastWAM-Joint post-training. Matching checkpoint, demonstrations/data, source implementation, and local hardware access are unconfirmed.
intake.compute: 本阶段只做文献与机制诊断；没有GPU/cluster实验授权。不假定GPU-day或美元预算。ASPIRE2A login仅轻量控制；加速方法保持training-free，baseline原有post-training单列。
intake.expertise: 按FYP研究者有WAM/robotics系统阅读与复现需求处理；具体实现经验、硬件及机器人权限未核实。
intake.baseline: FastWAM-Joint、Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID，以及作为近邻锚点的Sparse-WAM。FastWAM-Joint匹配checkpoint尚未确认；Cosmos3 Edge公开4B checkpoint已记录。Motus/RoboTwin 2.0仅为条件仿真后备，不替代FastWAM-Joint。跨模型比较需各自冻结checkpoint；任务所需baseline post-training另计。
intake.limitation: 待检的结构性余量是：future-side token/step reduction后，每个action solver update仍处理哪些observation/future conditioning，以及移除这些交互对动作质量和计算量的实际影响；这些依赖、成本占比与跨骨干转移尚未证实。论文时延与真机deadline口径差异是可行性/评测条件，不单独构成计算机制缺口。

bottleneck_statement: 对冻结权重、以迭代flow/diffusion联合生成future video与action chunk的WAM，future侧变稀疏或减少video updates后，当前方法仍在每个运行中的action solver step基于当前observation及保留上下文更新动作：Sparse-WAM保留全部observation/action tokens并逐step重算动作 [arxiv:2609.38984v1]；Efficient-WAM中可单独视为training-free的inference子机制把video压到两步并缓存video K/V，但action仍跑5/10步 [openalex:W7164153965]。现有证据没有区分这些action-conditioned context交互对动作质量的依赖与实际计算贡献，因此无法判断它们是否是可移除且值得加速的对象；FastWAM-Joint的32步action chunk也意味着余量不可由token保留或总时延推断。论文时延与真机deadline口径差异只是评测/部署条件：WAMachine已测observation-to-action latency并利用执行期slack做rebind，RTC/RTI/GlanceWAM等也覆盖相邻的异步或warm-start路线；把deadline改名不能形成新的training-free计算机制。

closest_adjacent.summary_and_residue: 它用action-to-future attention保留逐帧core tokens与共享anchors，跨denoising steps复用选择和省略区域的velocity，同时每步重算action predictions。它仍保留全部observation/action tokens，未分离这些context对动作质量的敏感性或其计算占比；32步action chunk本身不证明该路径重要。

它组合trajectory remapping、执行slack中的speculative denoising/observation rebinding，以及probe-gated residual rescaling跳过中间层，并报告仿真中的GPU denoising time和observation-to-action latency。它已覆盖状态复用、异步rebind与RTI-DP/RTC邻域；论文时延与真机deadline口径仍是部署评测差异，不能单独充当新计算机制。
其整体模型经过三阶段训练，但inference-only的asymmetric denoising使用两次joint video更新、5/10次action更新，并缓存video K/V。该组件已覆盖不对称denoising/KV复用，却没有建立action-context交互的质量依赖与成本占比；整体模型不能冒充frozen training-free baseline。

它在action-only Fast-WAM的action expert上跨inference chunks复用denoising residual，并用缓存步区间和refresh间隔控制质量/速度权衡。这个cross-chunk residual reuse不回答joint FastWAM-Joint每个action update需要哪些当前observation/future context，也不能直接证明相同缓存路径适用于joint backbone。

FBFM在flow execution期间把新观测编码成state latent约束，以endpoint-Jacobian/pseudoinverse修正velocity并固定已提交action overlap。其JVP/feedback管理增加开销，真实机器人材料是recorded-ball replay诊断而非closed-loop任务，因此既未量化本处context成本，也未证明真机deadline收益。
GlanceWAM以异步lookahead生成稀疏future imagination，并训练staleness robustness以便未来生成与执行重叠。它已占据异步future/staleness机制邻域，但包含co-training，不能作为frozen-baseline training-free inference comparator，也未分解每步action-context交互。

what_phase_0_did_not_address: 在Sparse-WAM这类future token已稀疏的joint-WAM上，尚未建立action输出对每步所读observation/future context的质量敏感性与对应计算量之间的边界；尤其FastWAM-Joint的action chunk只有32步，保留全部tokens不能说明action侧是主要成本，固定observation latent也不代表hidden states或KV跨timestep固定。 — stakes: 研究者可能把有限实验预算投入占比很小的路径，或删去接触/遮挡相关条件而降低控制质量；没有敏感性边界也使跨backbone加速结果难以解释。

在joint WAM把future表示稀疏化或缓存后，是否仍必须让每个native action update使用完整可见observation与保留future context，还是该dense conditioning只是继承自joint predictor的默认接口，尚未被检验。 — stakes: 若这一继承假设实际决定了动作质量与计算的取舍，工程师可能把失败误判为backbone限制，研究结论也会局限于共同保留了同一未验证conditioning graph的模型。

method_lineage.line: Observation-conditioned iterative denoising/flow for action chunks, extended to joint future-video and action generation; the diagnostic concerns repeated action-query conditioning compute.

nodes.move: Root move: use repeated stochastic updates driven by a target-distribution score to obtain samples rather than a one-shot prediction.
nodes.residual_problem: Sampling requires repeated score evaluations; later diffusion methods learn a denoising field but retain iterative inference cost.

nodes.method: Denoising score matching and noise-conditional score models
nodes.move: Learns a score/denoising direction from progressively corrupted samples, making the iterative sampling field data-driven.
nodes.residual_problem: A trained denoising field still needs repeated noise-level evaluations to reach a sample.

nodes.move: Organizes denoising into a learned noise schedule and reverse transitions that can be conditioned on context.
nodes.residual_problem: Multi-step inference repeatedly processes a context-conditioned sample and can be expensive for control latency.

nodes.move: Applies conditional iterative denoising to whole robot action trajectories/chunks, using observation context to generate multimodal actions.
nodes.residual_problem: The action trajectory is revisited across solver steps; later WAMs add a future-video stream and cross-modal conditioning.

nodes.move: Adds explicit future-video prediction jointly with action generation, coupling visual and action denoising in a WAM.
nodes.residual_problem: Joint inference repeats conditioned video/action computation; it does not specify which action-query context interactions are necessary at every active solver step.

nodes.move: Selects action-relevant future visual tokens and reuses selection/omitted-region predictions across denoising steps.
nodes.residual_problem: It keeps all observation/action tokens and recomputes action predictions each step; action-context sensitivity and cost share remain unestablished.

nodes.move: Runs a short video schedule, caches video K/V, and continues a longer action schedule; the model as a whole is trained and is not a frozen training-free baseline.
nodes.residual_problem: Action updates continue after video updates stop, but their per-step context dependence and share of total compute are not isolated.

nodes.move: Reuses/remaps states across replans, speculative observation rebinding during execution, and probe-gated intermediate-layer residuals.
nodes.residual_problem: Consistency failures refresh computation; the paper establishes O2A/slack-aware acceleration but not the action-context sensitivity/cost boundary or physical closed-loop result.

nodes.move: Injects newly observed state constraints and committed action overlap into the active flow update through Jacobian/pseudoinverse feedback.
nodes.residual_problem: Feedback/JVP management has cost and the real-robot evidence is replay-only; the action-context computation itself is not isolated.

nodes.move: Overlaps sparse future imagination with execution using asynchronous lookahead and staleness-robust training.
nodes.residual_problem: Staleness boundaries depend on control rate/hardware and the co-trained method is not a frozen-baseline training-free inference comparator.

nodes.move: Collateral family: reduces generic sequence-attention work through locality-sensitive sparse interactions rather than WAM-specific action conditioning.
nodes.residual_problem: It does not establish which observation/future interactions are required to preserve action quality in a joint WAM.

nodes.move: Collateral family: approximates softmax attention with a linearized feature computation.
nodes.residual_problem: Generic attention approximation does not provide the WAM action-quality boundary for changing cross-modal context.

nodes.move: Collateral family: reduces later computation by dropping tokens judged less useful for visual recognition.
nodes.residual_problem: Visual recognition token utility does not specify action-conditioned context sufficiency in a denoising WAM.

nodes.move: Collateral family: exits selected visual tokens at different depths to spend compute unevenly.
nodes.residual_problem: Per-token visual halting does not measure control sensitivity to removing context from each WAM action update.

nodes.move: Collateral family: reuses selected intermediate diffusion features across nearby sampling steps.
nodes.residual_problem: Generic feature similarity/reuse does not establish cross-modal action-context necessity under changing WAM timesteps and masks.

method_lineage.notes: Retrieved nodes are the recent frontier; parametric lineage/collateral nodes are awareness-only and do not support prior-art or novelty claims. The Fast-WAM anchor is present in the fulltext index as a user reference; it is used for the ancestry line, not as a closest_adjacent paper-id. Older collateral families recognized for this residual include sparse attention (Reformer), linear attention (Performer), token pruning (DynamicViT), adaptive token halting (A-ViT), and diffusion-feature reuse (DeepCache); none establishes the WAM-specific action-quality/context-cost boundary. Do not infer compute headroom from token retention: the action sequence is short, Amdahl/profile measurements would be required, and a fixed observation latent does not imply fixed hidden states/KV across masks, timestep modulation, or changing future/action conditions. WAMachine already reports O2A and uses execution-period slack; RTC/RTI warm-start or overlap and GlanceWAM asynchronous lookahead occupy adjacent execution-scheduling axes, so paper timing versus physical deadline is an evaluation/feasibility concern, not a new mechanism. Adaptation to FastWAM-Joint and Cosmos3-Edge and matching robot artifacts/checkpoints are feasibility conditions only; no generalization or physical success is claimed, and no GPU experiment is authorized.

domain_pattern_distribution.notes: architectural_operator_substitution is the most-used pattern (20/47, 0.43); adjacent WAM works apply it to distinct compute objects, so no shared limitation is visible.
